channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: Classic r12 services the speaker FIFO from a 2 ms hardware timer so block callbacks cannot delay playback. It reuses the previous scratch memory for an extra queued block and retains a frame when space opens during its callback. P25 gain and the existing MIT IMBE codec are unchanged; this public line remains FM, DMR and conventional P25. Existing RFKV programming, RX-only defaults, transmit checks and codec slot are preserved. Full host and sanitizer tests, target stack/ABI checks, zero-warning builds and a byte-identical forced rebuild passed. Physical-radio qualification of r12 has not been performed. Known issues: PL/CTCSS can drop during DTMF, and intermittent P25 PTT startup with no RF remains under investigation.
